inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment DisjoiningPart returns SysML::Type :
	'disjoint' 'from' ownedRelationship += OwnedDisjoining
	( ',' ownedRelationship += OwnedDisjoining )* 
;

decision: As KerML 8.2.4.1.1 states it: 'disjoint' 'from', then one or more OwnedDisjoining separated by commas. The Xtext fragment is identical. The leading keyword is unique among TypeRelationshipPart's four alternatives in the same clause (`disjoint from`, `unions`, `intersects`, `differences`), so the alternatives do not overlap. TypeDeclaration, in the same clause, repeats relationship parts with `TypeRelationshipPart*`, so the same part may occur more than once. Repeating the keyword and continuing the comma list both accept a further target.

evidence.note: DisjoiningPart : Type = 'disjoint' 'from' ownedRelationship += OwnedDisjoining ( ',' ownedRelationship += OwnedDisjoining )*
line 9: `classifier YourBike [1] specializes Bicycle disjoint from MyBike;`
line 31: `feature h2 differences b.f, b.a intersects f.a, g disjoint from h1;`, after two other relationship parts
fragment DisjoiningPart: 'disjoint' 'from' ownedRelationship += OwnedDisjoining ( ',' ownedRelationship += OwnedDisjoining )*. Agrees.
